title: Build nested feed events
prompt: For each input row, build likeDislike struct(dislikes, likes, userAction) and multiMedia as a one-element array of struct(createAt, description, id, likeCount, mediatype, name, place, url). Retain parent description/id/mediatype/name; remove the other fields moved into the two nested columns. Match the expected nested schema; field order and nullability are not graded.
